cards.ex: She still uses her maiden name professionally, even though she's married.
cards.exUz: U turmushga chiqqan bo'lsa ham, professional faoliyatida hali ham qizlik familiyasidan foydalanadi.
cards.uzDef: Turmushga chiqishdan oldingi familiya, qizligidagi ismi.

cards.ex: I'm quite family-oriented, so spending time with my relatives is important to me.
cards.exUz: Men oilaparvarman, shuning uchun qarindoshlarim bilan vaqt o'tkazish men uchun muhim.
cards.uzDef: Oila bilan bog'liq narsalarga katta ahamiyat beradigan shaxs.

cards.ex: I hail from a small town in the mountains, but I've lived in the city for years.
cards.exUz: Men tog'lardagi kichik shaharchadan kelib chiqqanman, lekin men shaharda yillar davomida yashadim.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir joydan, asosan shahardan yoki mamlakatdan kelib chiqish.

cards.ex: My grandparents are near and dear to my heart; I visit them every month.
cards.exUz: Mening buvim va bobom menga juda qadrdon; men ularni har oy ziyorat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin va qadrdon bo'lgan odamlar yoki narsalar.

cards.ex: My brother and I are cut from the same cloth; we're both stubborn and independent.
cards.exUz: Akam bilan bizning xarakterimiz bir xil; ikkalamiz ham qaysar va mustaqilmiz.
cards.uzDef: Xarakteri, fe'l-atvori o'xshash bo'lgan odamlar.

cards.ex: My formative years were spent in a boarding school, which taught me discipline.
cards.exUz: Mening shakllanish yillarim internatda o'tdi, bu menga intizomni o'rgatdi.
cards.uzDef: Bolalik va o'smirlik davri, shaxsning shakllanish yillari.

cards.ex: I always speak my mind, even if it's not always what people want to hear.
cards.exUz: Men har doim o'z fikrimni ochiq aytaman, garchi bu har doim odamlarga yoqmasa ham.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini ochiq, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ifoda etmoq.

cards.ex: I'm a creature of habit; I always have coffee at the same time every morning.
cards.exUz: Men odat quliman; men har doim har kuni ertalab bir xil vaqtda qahva ichaman.
cards.uzDef: O'z odatlariga qattiq rioya qiladigan, o'zgarishni yoqtirmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: On a personal note, I found the movie deeply moving and thought-provoking.
cards.exUz: Shaxsiy fikrimcha, men bu filmni juda ta'sirli va fikr yuritishga undovchi deb topdim.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy fikrni yoki voqeani aytishni boshlashda ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: Coming from a family of doctors, I always felt pressure to study medicine.
cards.exUz: Shifokorlar oilasidan kelib chiqqanim uchun, men doim tibbiyotni o'rganish uchun bosim his qilardim.
cards.uzDef: So'zlovchining kelib chiqishi, tajribasi yoki nuqtai nazarini ko'rsatadi.

cards.ex: At this stage, I'm focused on developing my career and gaining more experience.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi bosqichda men o'z kareramni rivojlantirishga va ko'proq tajriba orttirishga e'tibor qaratganman.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi vaqtda, joriy vaziyatda.

cards.ex: It might be difficult now, but in the long run, this decision will benefit us.
cards.exUz: Hozir qiyin bo'lishi mumkin, lekin uzoq muddatda bu qaror bizga foyda keltiradi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda, uzoq vaqt o'tgach.

cards.ex: My life's ambition is to travel the world and experience different cultures.
cards.exUz: Mening hayotiy maqsadim dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilish va turli madaniyatlarni his qilish.
cards.uzDef: Inson hayot davomida erishmoqchi bo'lgan asosiy maqsadi.

cards.ex: I define myself as a creative and driven individual who enjoys challenges.
cards.exUz: Men o'zimni ijodkor va maqsadga intiluvchi, qiyinchiliklardan zavqlanadigan shaxs sifatida ta'riflayman.
cards.uzDef: O'z shaxsiyatini, xususiyatlarini aniq ifodalash.

cards.ex: It's hard to get a word in when he's talking; he dominates the conversation.
cards.exUz: U gapirayotganda gapga qo'shilish qiyin; u suhbatda hukmronlik qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Suhbatda gapirish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Plain and simple, I'm not interested in joining the committee.
cards.exUz: Oddiy va tushunarli qilib aytganda, men qo'mitaga qo'shilishga qiziqmayman.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday murakkabliksiz, oson tushunsa bo'ladigan tarzda.

cards.ex: She became successful in her own right, without any help from her family.
cards.exUz: U o'zining qobiliyatlari bilan, oilasidan hech qanday yordamisiz muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z qobiliyatlari, mehnatlari orqali, boshqalarga suyanmasdan.

cards.ex: I'd say I'm a pretty optimistic person, even when things get tough.
cards.exUz: Men aytardimki, men juda optimistik odamman, hatto ishlar qiyinlashganda ham.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini, taxminini bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: On the whole, I'm satisfied with my career and personal life.
cards.exUz: Umuman olganda, men o'z kareram va shaxsiy hayotimdan qoniqaman.
cards.uzDef: Umuman, asosan, ko'p jihatdan.

cards.ex: To put it mildly, the project was a complete disaster.
cards.exUz: Yumshoq qilib aytsak, loyiha to'liq muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni yumshoqroq, kamroq keskin tarzda ifodalash.

cards.ex: I grew up in a close-knit community where everyone knew each other.
cards.exUz: Men hamma bir-birini biladigan ahil jamoada ulg'aydim.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biri bilan yaqin aloqada bo'lgan, do'stona munosabatda bo'lgan.

cards.ex: I have a keen interest in history and archaeology.
cards.exUz: Mening tarix va arxeologiyaga katta qiziqishim bor.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir juda katta qiziqishi bo'lishi.

cards.ex: First and foremost, I'm a writer, but I also work as a teacher.
cards.exUz: Eng avvalo, men yozuvchiman, lekin men o'qituvchi bo'lib ham ishlayman.
cards.uzDef: Eng muhimi, birinchi navbatda.

cards.ex: In retrospect, I realize that I made the wrong decision.
cards.exUz: O'tmishga nazar tashlab, men noto'g'ri qaror qabul qilganimni angladim.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi voqealarni eslab, ularga yangicha nazar bilan qarash.

cards.ex: Graduating from university was a defining moment in my life.
cards.exUz: Universitetni tugatish mening hayotimdagi hal qiluvchi lahza edi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotdagi muhim voqea, taqdirni o'zgartiruvchi payt.

cards.ex: I take after my mother in terms of personality; we're both very patient.
cards.exUz: Men xarakterim bo'yicha onamga o'xshayman; ikkalamiz ham juda sabrlimiz.
cards.uzDef: Ota-onasiga yoki boshqa qarindoshlariga tashqi ko'rinishi yoki xarakteri bilan o'xshash bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: I sometimes get carried away when I'm talking about my passions.
cards.exUz: Men ba'zan o'z ishtiyoqlarim haqida gapirganda haddan oshib ketaman.
cards.uzDef: Hissiyotlarga berilib, o'zini tuta olmaslik.

cards.ex: I draw inspiration from nature and the world around me.
cards.exUz: Men tabiatdan va atrofimdagi dunyodan ilhom olaman.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsadan ilhom olmoq, ruhlanmoq.

cards.ex: I use English on a daily basis at work and in my personal life.
cards.exUz: Men ingliz tilidan har kuni ishda va shaxsiy hayotimda foydalanaman.
cards.uzDef: Kunlik ravishda, har bir kunda sodir bo'ladigan narsa.

cards.ex: Traveling helps me broaden my horizons and understand different cultures.
cards.exUz: Sayohat qilish menga dunyoqarashimni kengaytirishga va turli madaniyatlar haqida tushunchaga ega bo'lishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi tajribalar orqali bilim va tushunchalarni oshirish.
